# INSTALL THE *healthiar* R PACKAGE FROM GITHUB

(Requirement: R version 4.3.0 or higher)

Run the following commands below in RStudio to install *healthiar* 1)
`install.packages(c("remotes", "knitr", "rmarkdown"))` 2)
`remotes::install_github(repo = "SwissTPH/healthiar", build_vignettes = TRUE)`
3) If you get asked to install or update any dependencies (= other
packages that are needed for *healthiar*) please install or update all
of them. 4)
[`library(healthiar)`](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=healthiar)

## Load the package

Do not forget to load the package after the installation entering in
your R console:
[`library(healthiar)`](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=healthiar).

## Requirement

R version 4.3.0 or higher.

If you had previously installed *healthiar* while the repository was
still private, you must remove your personal access token (PAT) before
installing the package again.

# GET STARTED WITH *healthiar*

A 45’ minutes introduction to the package can be found here:
<https://team.swisstph.ch/s/aN_wN5MUTAS3bwEkWvtvaQ>

The slides of the presentation can be found here:
<https://github.com/SwissTPH/healthiar/tree/master/varia/Workshops_and_demos/workshop>

The vignette *intro_to_healthiar* (i.e. documentation on how to use the
healthiar package) will get you started with the *healthiar* R
package. 1) Open it in RStudio: go to the *Packages* tab in RStudio,
scroll down to the *healthiar* package and clicking on the hyperlinks
*healthiar* \> *User guides, package vignettes and other documentation*
\> *healthiar::intro_to_healthiar* 2) Open it in browser: run
`browseVignettes("healthiar")` in the console and click on the *HTML*
hyperlink on the page that opens up in your browser

# CITATION

We love that you use *healthiar*. In that case, please do not forget to
cite *healthiar* in your work. Two options to get there:

1.  In your R console, enter *citation(“healthiar”)*

2.  See
    [CITATION.R](https://github.com/SwissTPH/healthiar/blob/master/inst/CITATION)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`attribute_health()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/attribute_health.md)
  : Attribute health impacts to an environmental stressor
- [`attribute_lifetable()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/attribute_lifetable.md)
  : Attribute premature deaths or YLL to an environmental stressor using
  a life table approach
- [`attribute_mod()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/attribute_mod.md)
  : Create a scenario 2 by modifying an existing scenario 1 and
  determine attributable health impacts in it
- [`cba()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/cba.md) :
  Cost-benefit analysis
- [`compare()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/compare.md)
  : Compare the attributable health impacts between two scenarios
- [`daly()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/daly.md) :
  Attributable disability-adjusted life years
- [`discount()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/discount.md)
  : Discount health impacts
- [`get_discount_factor()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/get_discount_factor.md)
  : Get discount factor
- [`get_inflation_factor()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/get_inflation_factor.md)
  : Get inflation factor
- [`get_paf()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/get_paf.md)
  : Get population attributable fraction
- [`get_pif()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/get_pif.md)
  : Get population impact fraction
- [`get_risk()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/get_risk.md)
  : Get the relative risk of an exposure level
- [`monetize()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/monetize.md)
  : Monetize health impacts
- [`multiexpose()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/multiexpose.md)
  : Aggregate health impacts from multiple exposures
- [`prepare_exposure()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/prepare_exposure.md)
  : Prepare exposure data
- [`prepare_lifetable()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/prepare_lifetable.md)
  : Convert multi-year life table to single year life table
- [`prepare_mdi()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/prepare_mdi.md)
  : Create the BEST-COST Multidimensional Deprivation Index (MDI)
- [`socialize()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/socialize.md)
  : Consider socio-economic aspects in healthiar assessments
- [`standardize()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/standardize.md)
  : Obtain age-standardized health impacts
- [`summarize_uncertainty()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/reference/summarize_uncertainty.md)
  : Get Monte Carlo confidence intervals
